suppress.notes: moment.js CVEs bundled in chart.js@2.9.4 (Chart.bundle.min.js). CVE-2022-24785 (path traversal in moment.locale) is Node-only, not exploitable in the browser. CVE-2022-31129 (ReDoS on very long date strings) requires user-controlled input into moment.parse, which does not occur - chart.js on the metadata-quality page renders backend-controlled numbers only. Both are resolved by chart.js v2 -> v4 upgrade tracked in GOVDATADE-XXXX (moment is no longer bundled in chart.js v3+).

nanoid 3.3.16+ - false positive. CVE-2026-67214 (infinite loop in customAlphabet/nanoid of nanoid/non-secure) is fixed in 3.3.16 (3.x branch) and 5.1.16 (5.x branch). Installed version 3.3.18 contains the fix; overrides in webapp/package.json pin nanoid to at least ^3.3.18 to prevent regressions. OWASP Dependency-Check matches on CPE without evaluating fixed-version metadata. Uses packageUrl regex because the npm analyzer identifies dependencies by PURL rather than a node_modules filepath.
